Job Opportunities

Career Opportunities

Gapblue Software Labs Pvt Ltd

0484-4010593
hr.support@gapblue.com

Business Analyst - AI & Enterprise Solutions (Only looking for candidates based in Kerala)

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join our AI and Digital Transformation practice, serving as the critical bridge between our technical teams and business stakeholders. This role involves leading requirements gathering, process analysis, and solution design for AI-powered enterprise solutions, with a particular focus on procurement and supply chain transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Management
• Interface directly with client stakeholders to understand business processes, pain points, and transformation objectives
• Conduct comprehensive discovery sessions and workshops to elicit, document, and validate business requirements
• Translate complex business needs into clear functional specifications for AI and automation solutions
• Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment between business vision and technical implementation
AI Project Delivery
• Support the implementation of AI-powered procurement automation solutions including intelligent document processing, automated vendor management, and predictive analytics
• Collaborate with data scientists and AI engineers to ensure business requirements are properly addressed in solution design
• Develop use cases and user stories for AI features within enterprise systems
• Create process maps and solution blueprints for AI integration with existing ERP landscapes
ERP & Process Analysis
• Analyze current state procurement processes and identify opportunities for AI-driven optimization
• Document AS-IS and TO-BE process flows, highlighting areas for intelligent automation
• Assess integration requirements between AI solutions and Oracle Fusion or other ERP platforms
• Support change management initiatives by developing training materials and conducting user sessions
Solution Design & Documentation
• Create detailed functional specifications, data mapping documents, and integration requirements
• Develop business cases and ROI analyses for proposed AI solutions
• Prepare test scenarios and support UAT activities
• Maintain comprehensive project documentation including requirements traceability matrices
Client Engagement & Travel
• Travel to client sites across UAE and potentially Saudi Arabia for requirement gathering, workshops, and solution presentations (up to 30-40% travel)
• Lead client presentations and demonstrations of proposed solutions
• Build strong relationships with client teams and serve as a trusted advisor

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field
• 4-7 years of experience as a Business Analyst in enterprise software implementations
• Proven track record in ERP-related projects, preferably in procurement, supply chain, or finance modules
Technical Skills
• ERP Experience (Required):
o Hands-on functional experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud applications (Procurement, Sourcing, Supplier Portal, or related modules) - strongly preferred
o Alternative ERP experience in procurement modules (SAP Ariba, SAP MM, Oracle EBS, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.) will be considered
o Understanding of P2P (Procure-to-Pay) business processes
• AI & Analytics Knowledge (Preferred):
o Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and their application in business contexts
o Experience with process mining, RPA, or intelligent automation projects
o Understanding of data analytics and visualization tools

Core Competencies
• Communication Excellence:
o Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English
o Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
o Strong presentation and facilitation skills
o Experience conducting workshops and training sessions
• Analytical Skills:
o Strong problem-solving abilities with attention to detail
o Ability to analyze complex business processes and identify improvement opportunities
o Data-driven mindset with experience in creating business cases
• Project Management:
o Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
o Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
o Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools

Personal Attributes
• Willingness to travel regionally (UAE, Saudi Arabia) as required
• Self-motivated with ability to work independently and as part of a team
• Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
• Client-focused mindset with strong interpersonal skills
• Curious and eager to learn new technologies and business domains

Preferred Additional Qualifications
• MBA or relevant master's degree
• Professional certifications such as CBAP, PMP, or Agile certifications
• Oracle Cloud certification in relevant modules
• Experience with UAE or GCC market dynamics and business practices
• Arabic language skills (advantageous but not required)
• Experience in Oil & Gas, Construction, or Government sectors
• Knowledge of UAE procurement regulations and compliance requirements

If this opportunity aligns with your career goals, kindly share your updated resume with us at jeni.jayan@gapblue.com
